name: postcombat_main_second_land_refused
note: CR 305.2: a player can normally play one land during their turn, so the land play is one per turn in total, not one per main phase. P0 plays a Forest in the first main phase, attacks, and the second Forest is refused in the second main phase because the turn's land play is used ('land:used_this_turn'), not because of the phase. Red on main d0200d2: the refusal was 'land:phase' (land drops were first-main-only, B-74). Twin: postcombat_main_land_drop.
